tasks.short: Design or improve electrical equipment and systems

steps.what: File load, voltage, duty and site limits
Choose or improve the electrical concept
Draft the design note from the template

loop.input: duty fields and the accepted calculation id
loop.output: design note with each figure tagged to a field
loop.check: Every figure equals a duty field or the accepted calculation
loop.stop: Leave the figure blank and stop that sentence if it has no field
loop.why_not_simpler: Concept prose is not a fixed lookup, but a figure must not be invented

steps.what: Comment on the note against the duty
Sign the issued design version
Maintain or install the signed version
File the signed design version

tasks.design: The project controller files load, voltage, duty and site limits on a {WORKFLOW} form. A bounded draft in {DOCS} writes the design note only from those fields and from a calculation the engineer has already accepted. The electrical engineer signs one version. The technician maintains or installs only that version. The concept is not chosen by a draft.
tasks.previous_blocker: Load figures, site limits and concept notes lived in different mail threads, so a draft could not show which number it used.
tasks.enabler_now: The same equipment id can sit on the duty form and on the accepted calculation, so each figure in the note can be checked against a field.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing or improving the concept, and what may change on a live site, is still the engineer's judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The electrical engineer chooses the concept and is the person who signs the issued design.

ambition.what: Re-issue the design after each accepted site change, not only at the first release

tasks.altitude: Less time rewriting the note. The engineer can still refuse a concept, and can block an install that has no signed version.

reach.task: Maintain or install the signed design version
reach.learn: Which version is signed and which site limits are still open

evidence.claim: In a mid-size firm this work is a concept choice plus a design note. The note can sit on a template. The concept cannot.
Digest [S12] and [S13] say safety components in electricity can be high-risk under the EU AI Act. The electrical engineer still signs. A draft is not the issued design.
Digest [S20] says a paper was withdrawn over untrusted data. Do not file a model-written number in the design note.

assumptions: Focal role is the electrical engineer. The task ends when a signed design version is filed. Manufacturing the equipment is a later task.

Input contract: equipment id, load, voltage, duty, site limit, standard clause id, calculation id. The project controller produces the site limits. The engineer produces the calculation id. If a field is empty the engineer types it and marks the row manual.
Use the document store's own templates and approval flow before custom code. The concept choice is not a template.
unknowns: Whether this design is a safety component of an electrical system.
Who may sign when the electrical engineer is absent.
Which sites still have no equipment id.
research_questions: What share of design notes contain a figure with no input field?
How often is an issued design changed after the technician is on site?

already_counted.description: Engineer time on the concept choice stays in the remaining share
Engineer edits to the design note stay in the remaining share
Signature time stays in the remaining share and is not deducted again

incremental.description: Revise the design-note template when a new equipment type appears
Project controllers correct duty forms the check rejects

approvals.approved_version: design version signed in this review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes most jobs still arrive as free-text mail, so the engineer rewrites the note by hand. The high case assumes the form is used but every concept and every signature stays with the engineer. Site work is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Oversee production so work stays on time and in budget

steps.what: Post production hours, spend and dates
Read slips against date and budget
Oversee and decide accept or replan
Draft the steer note from posted figures

loop.input: signed steer and posted milestone rows
loop.output: note that cites only posted figures
loop.check: Every figure equals a posted milestone row
loop.stop: Drop the sentence if the figure has no milestone id
loop.why_not_simpler: The reason for the steer is not a fixed sentence, but the figure must come from the row

steps.what: Update the plan from the signed steer
File the steer note

tasks.design: The project controller posts hours, spend and milestone dates on {PROJECT}. A {BI} view shows only rows that miss the date or the budget. The electrical engineer decides which slips to accept. A note in {DOCS} may repeat only those posted figures. A model-written number is not filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Hours and costs arrived in separate workbooks, so a status line could not be tied to one milestone id.
tasks.enabler_now: A milestone id can join the posted hours, the spend and the date, so the view can flag a miss without a rewritten pack.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a late activity is accepted, replanned or stopped is still a judgement about the job.
tasks.human_edge: The electrical engineer decides the steer. The project controller does not sign that decision.

ambition.what: Review production slips every week from the same milestone rows, not only when a meeting is called

tasks.altitude: The week moves from building the status pack to deciding the slips. The engineer can refuse a steer that cites a figure not on the posted rows.

reach.task: Update plan dates after the signed steer
reach.learn: Which slips the engineer accepted and which figures were blank

evidence.claim: Oversight in a mid-size firm sits in a status meeting and a workbook pack. The pack can become a view. The steer cannot.
Digest [S20] says a paper was withdrawn over untrusted data. A status note must not file a model-written number.

assumptions: Focal role is the electrical engineer. The task ends at a signed steer. Doing the production work is not this task.

Input contract: project id, milestone id, planned date, actual date, hours, spend, budget. Producer is the project controller. A row with no milestone id stays off the view and is handled in the meeting.
The meeting prior fits the steer. Building the pack is workbook and screen time. Configure the project tool's own fields before custom code.
unknowns: Who may change a milestone date besides the electrical engineer.
Whether hours are posted daily or only at month end.
research_questions: What share of milestones has no posted actual date?
How often does the steer reverse the first reading of a slip?

already_counted.description: Meeting time on the steer stays in the remaining share
Edits to the steer note stay in the remaining share

incremental.description: Keep milestone fields aligned when a new project type is added
Project controllers repost rows the view rejects

approvals.approved_version: production steer signed in this meeting

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes hours still arrive as free text, so the engineer rebuilds the pack. The high case assumes the view is current but every steer stays in the meeting. Production labour is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct installation and testing against the specification

steps.what: Post the activity list and spec ids
Direct the crew against that spec
Do the install, build or test
Log the reading against the spec id
Flag a reading outside the signed limit
Comment on a reading that failed
Sign pass, rework or waiver

tasks.design: The electrical engineer directs the crew in person against a spec id on {PROJECT}. The technician records readings on a {WORKFLOW} form. A {SPREADSHEET} check marks a reading outside the signed limit. The engineer decides pass, rework or waiver and signs that record in {DOCS}. Site direction is not handed to a model.
tasks.previous_blocker: Instructions, readings and code clauses were spread across mail and paper, so a pass could not be tied to one spec id.
tasks.enabler_now: A spec id can sit on the instruction, the reading and the limit, so an out-of-limit row can be flagged before the engineer decides.
tasks.still_hard: Directing the crew, and waiving a miss against a code or a customer requirement, stays with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The electrical engineer directs the activity and signs the compliance record. A flagged row is not a waiver.

ambition.what: Close each activity against its spec id in the same week, not in a later paperwork batch

tasks.altitude: Less time chasing readings. The site direction stays. The engineer can stop an activity that has no spec id.

reach.task: Record readings against the spec id the engineer named
reach.learn: Which activities are signed off and which readings are still outside the limit

evidence.claim: Directing installation and tests is mostly in person. The record of readings is the part that can be checked against a limit.
Digest [S14] says the machinery regulation covers AI safety functions from 20 January 2027. Waiving a safety function stays with the electrical engineer.
Digest [S12] and [S13] say safety components in electricity can be high-risk under the EU AI Act. The engineer still signs the compliance record.

assumptions: Focal role is the electrical engineer. The task runs from a directed activity to a signed compliance record. Writing the specification is a separate task.

Input contract: activity id, spec id, limit, unit, reading, technician id. The technician produces the reading. The limit comes from the signed specification. A reading with no spec id is not compared.

Native form fields are used before custom code. In-person direction is not replaced by a workflow. This design does not monitor staff performance, so works-council consent for monitoring is not required.
unknowns: Which codes apply on a customer site versus in the firm's own shop.
Who may waive a miss when the engineer is not on site.
Whether the activity includes a machinery safety function.
research_questions: What share of readings arrive with no spec id?
How often is the first on-site instruction changed the same day?

already_counted.description: In-person direction stays in the remaining share
Waiver judgement stays in the remaining share

incremental.description: Add a field when a new test type is directed
Technicians correct readings the form rejects

approvals.approved_version: compliance record signed for this activity id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes readings stay on paper, so the limit check rarely runs and the engineer still reconciles them. The high case assumes readings are filed but every direction and every waiver stays in person. Crew time is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Calculate the figures that set an installation specification

steps.what: Enter load, length, ambient and clause
Choose the method and the standard clause
Compute the result from those inputs
Compare the result with a second method
Draft the specification from the template

loop.input: traced results and the specification template
loop.output: specification whose figures each name a result id
loop.check: Every figure equals a traced result
loop.stop: Leave the figure blank and stop if the result id is missing
loop.why_not_simpler: Clause prose is not a fixed sentence, but a figure must not be invented

steps.what: Sign the specification version

tasks.design: The electrical engineer names the method and enters load, length, ambient and the clause on a {SPREADSHEET} sheet. The sheet computes only from those inputs. A {DOCS} template writes the specification, and every figure must equal a sheet output. The engineer signs that version. A model must not invent a figure.
tasks.previous_blocker: Inputs and results sat in personal workbooks, so a specification could repeat a figure that no longer matched the sheet.
tasks.enabler_now: Each input can be a named field, and the sheet can show the result beside the field it used.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the method, and whether the result is fit to issue as a specification, remains the engineer's call.
tasks.human_edge: The electrical engineer chooses the method and signs the specification. A computed figure is not yet the issued standard.

ambition.what: Recompute the specification when an input changes, instead of copying the last issued figure

tasks.altitude: Less time rekeying formulas. The engineer can refuse a specification whose figures do not match the sheet.

reach.task: Check an issued specification against the calculation id
reach.learn: Which figures trace to an input and which cells were left blank

evidence.claim: These calculations are usually a workbook plus a written specification. The sheet can recompute from inputs. The choice of method cannot.
Digest [S20] says a paper was withdrawn over untrusted data. Do not file a model-written number. Each issued figure must trace to an input.
Digest [S12] and [S13] say safety components in electricity can be high-risk under the EU AI Act. The engineer still signs the specification.

assumptions: Focal role is the electrical engineer. The task ends when the specification version is signed. Building to that specification is later.
Input contract: calc id, method id, load, length, ambient, material, standard clause id. Producer is the electrical engineer. If an input is missing the sheet does not emit a result for that row.
The meeting prior overstates this task. Time today is on the workbook and the specification. Use the workbook's own formulas before custom code.
unknowns: Which calculations have no stable method id.
Whether the specification defines a safety component in an electrical system.
research_questions: What share of issued figures cannot be traced to a named input?
How often does a second method disagree with the sheet?

already_counted.description: Method choice stays in the remaining share
Edits to the specification draft stay in the remaining share
Signature time stays in the remaining share

incremental.description: Add a method id when a repeated calculation has none

approvals.approved_version: specification version signed for this calc id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes most calculations have no method id, so the engineer still computes by hand. The high case assumes the sheet runs, but the engineer still chooses the method and signs every specification. No model-written figure is treated as a result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The engineer stops retyping design notes, status packs and specification figures, and keeps the week for concept choices, site direction and signatures.
reach: Design checkers receive a note whose figures already name an input field.
Technicians receive a signed version instead of a mail thread.
Project controllers see which production slips the engineer has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Write each issued figure so it names the input it came from.
Keep the concept choice separate from the note a template can fill.
Direct site work against a spec id a technician can close.
role.ambitious_version: Every issued design has a signed version, a traced calculation and a short list of accepted deviations.
